Commentary.Commentary: Well, ideally, we should have been in a position to state the series status at this stage. We lost the first ODI but there were hopes of having the remaining 2 games. Then came more Covid cases and the second game got shifted by a day. However, with another increase, both, the Irish and USA Cricket Boards have mutually agreed to CANCEL THE SERIES. Ireland's tour to the Caribbean still stands as of now while USA will need to see how badly have their finances been hit with this cancellation.
